name: Sobradinho (Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil)
description: Green field with a yellow isosceles triangle at the hoist bearing the municipal arms, extended by a yellow horizontal band with a red stripe into the fly.
history: Sobradinho is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed by Arcinoé Antônio Peixoto de Farias: the arms represent the municipal government, the yellow triangle the town of Sobradinho as the seat, and the stripes the spread of municipal power over the territory.

features.role: isosceles triangle at the hoist bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown
band of yellow, red and yellow extending from the triangle into the fly
